documents.exception_reason: Invoice OS-2026-1187 from Office Supplies Demo SRL is already in the system and approved for payment. Not paid twice.
CleanPro changed its bank account (IBAN) on 23 Oct, 4 days before this invoice. Confirm the change by phone with a known contact before paying.
The IBAN on the invoice (…9999) differs from the one on file (…1005). Possible payment fraud: verify by phone before paying.
Docking stations invoiced at €199.00, PO price €185.00 (+7.6%, over the 2% tolerance). 20 invoiced but only 12 delivered (DN-TN-7781).
Second TechNova invoice in 6 days just under the €5,000 team-lead limit (€4,961.00 each, €9,922.00 together). Needs head-of-department sign-off.

lines.name: Security guard hours, branch network, October

documents.exception_reason: SecureGuard's tax-compliance certificate expired on 30 Sep. Asked the supplier for a current one.
Bistro Corner Catering SRL isn't an approved supplier, and the invoice has no PO number. Procurement to check who ordered it.
Payment reminder for AP-2026-090: added as a note to the existing invoice, no new record.
Supplier asks when invoice PH-771 will be paid and says it sent its onboarding documents on 20 Oct. Procurement to confirm onboarding status.
